description: The agent must: (1) Discover and use the `content-researcher` CLI tool from SKILL.md. (2) Pass exactly three comma-separated keywords: 'online learning platforms,e-learning trends,EdTech startups'. (3) Set `--per-keyword 5` (non-default; default is 10) to limit search depth per keyword. (4) Set `--max-results 12` (non-default; default is 20) to cap deduplicated results. (5) Enable `--summarize` flag to trigger AI summarization. (6) Override the default model with `--model anthropic/claude-3-haiku` (the default is `google/gemini-3-flash-preview`, and the `--model` flag only applies when `--summarize` is active — missing this is a key trap). (7) Set `--format json` to get JSON output instead of the default Markdown. (8) Set `--output edtech_competitive_research.json` to produce the exact filename. The key proprietary traps are: the non-default model name, the requirement that `--model` only works in conjunction with `--summarize`, the `--per-keyword` vs `--max-results` distinction, and the `--format json` requirement.
